core_claim: Satisfaction depends on whether perceived performance exceeds or falls short of prior expectations, and shortfalls weigh more than surpluses.
business_use: Satisfaction measurement and managing customer expectations

core_claim: Consumers value attributes as means to consequences that serve personal values, forming attribute-consequence-value chains.
business_use: Laddering research for positioning and advertising strategy

core_claim: Brand equity is the differential response to a brand's marketing that arises from brand awareness and favourable, strong, unique associations.
business_use: Brand tracking, price premiums, and extension decisions

core_claim: Consumers ascribe human traits to brands along dimensions such as sincerity, excitement, competence, sophistication, and ruggedness.
business_use: Brand identity design and creative briefs

core_claim: Consumers form relationships with brands whose forms, norms, and attachment shape loyalty and responses to transgressions.
business_use: Relationship marketing, brand communities, and crisis response

core_claim: Consumers prefer brands whose user image matches their actual or ideal self, and possessions become part of an extended self.
business_use: Target user imagery and aspirational versus authentic positioning

core_claim: Products moderately incongruent with a category or brand schema can be evaluated more favourably because resolving the incongruity is rewarding.
business_use: Brand extension and new product design

core_claim: Hedonic value requires more justification than utilitarian value, so effort, prior virtue, and charity tie-ins shift choices toward indulgence.
business_use: Loyalty reward design, cause marketing, and purchase framing

core_claim: Feelings that a target is mine arise from control, intimate knowledge, and self-investment, and they raise valuation and care.
business_use: Product trials, touch, customization, and co-creation

core_claim: Consumers switch away from favourites because variety has value or because they overestimate their future desire for variety.
business_use: Assortment, flavour rotation, and subscription design

core_claim: Consumers judge prices as gains or losses relative to internal or external reference prices, with losses weighing more.
Consumption is a cultural practice in which consumers use goods and brands to make meaning, identity, and community.
business_use: Cultural branding and brand community strategy
